(ja)༄༅/ /gnyen sgrol yan lag drug pa'i bsnyen sgrub bya tshul gyi yi ge utpal gzhon nu'i phreng ba bzhugs so/ /dpag yas zhing gi rnam 'dren ji snya

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// gnyen sgrol yan lag drug pa'i bsnyen sgrub bya tshul gyi yi ge utpal gzhon nu'i phreng ba bzhugs so// dpag yas zhing gi rnam 'dren ji snyed kyi// bya grub phrin las rang gzugs yid 'phrog gar// dran pas srid zhi'i 'jigs sgrol bla ma dang*// dbyer med thugs rje myur mas rtag tu skyongs// gnyen chen lo tsā'i thugs gsang dpal be'ur// legs 'khyil byin rlabs drod ldan sgrol ma yi// sgrub thabs gsang chen bstan pa'i dga' 'tshal las// bsnyen yig utpal gzhon nu'i phreng ba bstar// de'ang 'dir slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub zhal snga nas kyis sgrol ma mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud la brten nas bkral ba rje btsun sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs gdams ngag dang bcas pa mdzad de/ slob dpon de nyid nas rim par ba liṃ ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba/ bi ma la gupta/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ paṇḍi pa chen po/ gnyen lo tsā ba/ gnang kha'u pa/ de gnyis ka las rje sa skya pa chen pos gsan te/ de nas kho bo cag gi rnam 'dren mtshungs med zung gi bar du rim par byon pa'i gnyen gyi sgrol ma yan lag drug par grags pa gang de ji ltar nyams su len pa la bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las sbyor ro// dang po bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas dben par phyag dar byas te/ sgrol ma'i sku rten bshams pa'i mdun la sogs pa gang bder/ zlum gtor gcig dang*/ nyer spyod spyi ltar bsham/ rang nyid kha lho phyogs su blta ba 'grigs na rab/ ma 'grigs na mos pa byas pa'i mdun du rdo rje dril bu me tog sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams dang*/ dang por 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro cha gsum gyi gtor ma bcas bsham mo// gnyis pa ni/ cha gsum gyi cho ga bsil gtor dor ba ma gtogs kun rig gi skabs bzhin btang*/

bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil sogs nas dharma ra ṇi rol mor bcas pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas sgrub thabs dngos ni/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de'ang skyabs 'gro ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri pad zla dang bcas pa'i steng du bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun sgrol ma'i spyi bor bla ma 'od dpag med bzhugs pa'i mdun phyogs su sgrol ma sogs yi dam/ g.yas su longs spyod rdzogs pa dang sprul pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ rgyab tu dam pa'i chos glegs bam gyi tshogs/ g.yon phyogs su byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan rang gi dge 'dun/ mtha' skor kun tu chos skyong ba'i srung ma nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs par gsal gdab/ yang na dpag bsam gyi shing lo 'dab 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa'i khar padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i steng du/ skyabs yul rnams sngar bzhin gsal btab kyang rung*/ skyabs yul bsdu na gtso mo de kho na'i ngo bo bla ma/ thugs sangs rgyas/ gsung chos/ sku dge 'dun kun 'dus te/ kun 'dus nor bu lugs su bsgoms kyang chog go /skyabs su 'gro mkhan ni/ de dag gi mdun du rang nyid 'khod pa'i mtha' skor du pha ma rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod de skyabs su 'gro bar bsams shing*/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs kyis skyabs 'gro ci nus byas mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs skyabs gsol gyi tshig brjod pas skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang gzhan gyi rgyud la bzhugs par bsams/ sems bskyed ni/ bdag gzhan 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang sogs don yid la bsam zhing lan gsum brjod/

rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar sogs kyis tshogs zhing spyan drangs nas rgyu tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang*/ 'bras bu lha'i zhal phyag sogs sgrub thabs kyi dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar bskyed/ 'on kyang dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dkyus der mi gsal yang zla ba la sku rgyab brten pa zhes pa'i rjes thogs su/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar srab mos sogs dang sbrel na rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs nas 'byung bas de ltar brjod na legs par sems so// rang nyid lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems yun ring du gtad pa'i bar gyis lhar bskyed/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du tāṃ ljang gu'i mthar/ sngags phreng kha dog dkar po lang thabs su gnas pa g.yas skor du yod pa la dmigs nas/ snying po yi ge bcu pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ gzungs ring yang cung zad bzla zhing dmigs pa ni/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pa'i sna las mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab par sprul te 'phags pa thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ sems can thams cad la 'od zer phog pas 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las bskyabs te sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas rje btsun ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu dang khyad par sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las rgyas pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'od zer ljang gu'i rnam par tshur bsdus nas rang la thim par bsams pa'i spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang*/ rang rje btsun ma'i sku snang stong zung 'jug dang*/ sngags kyi sgra grag stong zung 'jug dang*/ dran rtog thams cad rig tsam rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i zung 'jug brjod bral te rje btsun ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum dang nam yang ma yengs pa'i ngang nas sngags bzla ba ni gal che'o// thun bsdu ba na/

rje btsun ma sgrol mas bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las bskyab tu gsol/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las bsgral du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pa lta bu'i rang gang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu ste rang la thim par bsam mo// gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur zhes dang*/ 'bru gsum lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ lho phyogs po ta la nas sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa bdag la thugs rjes dgongs bzhin du bzhugs pas gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi sogs nas dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol gyi bar gyis dkar gtor cha bzhi nas 'byung ba ltar 'bul lo// gsum pa ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam bya/ spro na thun mtshams su/ rang rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pas/ rje btsun ma mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sogs nas phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gis bstod de rang la thim pa'i bar dkyus ltar bya'o// de lta bu'i tshul gyis yi ge bcu pa 'bum phrag bcu gsum mam brgyad cu'i grangs kyi bsnyen pa ste bsnyen pa'o// gnyis pa sgrub pa bya bar 'dod na/ bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa des/ maṇḍal la brten te dbang du bya ba ni/ gnas dben par zangs la sogs pa'i maṇḍal la 'bras dmar po'am smug rtsis kha bsgyur ba'i tshom bu la bkod la/ nyer spyod dang mdun du gtor ma dmar po gcig bcas bshams la/

mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa yan chad gong bzhin sngon du song nas/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ tāṃ yig dmar po las utpal dmar po tāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon utpal dmar po 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum pa sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ dbu skra li ba g.yon phyogs su brdzes shing g.yas ngos nas mar cung zad 'phyang ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i cha lugs can/ dar srab mo'i stod g.yogs kyis nu ma bkab cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang ba'i g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du tām̐ yig dmar po sogs nas de la dbang bskur ba dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug pa dang*/ gnas lngar byin gyis brlab pa rnams sngar bzhin byas la/ de nas rang gi snying gar tāṃ yig dmar po las rje btsun ma rang 'dra ba dpag tu med pa spros te/ rgyal po la sogs pa gang la bya ba de'i snying gar lcags kyus phug mgrin par utpa la'i zhags pas bcings te mdun gyi maṇḍal gyi steng du bdag la gus pa'i tshul gyis 'gugs par bsam mo// yang snying ga'i tāṃ gi 'od dmar po des lus la phog pas dmar lam song bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ che ge mo wa sham ṇā ye zhes bzlas so// thun 'jog kar bsgrub bya bdag la bstim la/ gtor ma btang ba sogs gong bzhin bya'o// de lta bu'i thun bzhi'i nges pas zhag bco lnga nas 'grub par 'gyur ba ste sgrub pa'o// bzhi pa las tshogs ni yi ge rnying pa las 'byung ba bzhin shes par bya'o// gnyen chen sgrol ma'i bsnyen sgrub yi ge'i rnga// brgyud ldan gsung gi dbyig gus bskul ba'i mod// rnam gsal dbyangs su ldir byas dge ba'i tshogs// brtse chen snying po'i lugs bzang rgyas phyir bsngo// zhes gnyen sgrol yan lag drug pa'i bsnyen sgrub bya tshul gyi yi ge utpal gzhon nu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni dge slong kun dga' rgya mtsho'i ngor bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ//

// ༄༅// rdo rje phag mo dkar mo shes rab gsal byed ma'i bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge nyung gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// rdo rje phag mo chos kun la// bsnyengs bral blo gros mchog ster mar// phyag 'tshal bsnyen pa bya tshul 'dri// 'dir slob dpon chen po kaṅka byin nas brgyud pa'i rdo rje phag mo dkar mo shes rab gsal byed ma'i bsnyen pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ gnas dben par byi dor byas pa la/ dkon mchog gi rten spyi dang bye brag 'di'i sku rten yod na bshams/ de'i mdun du gtor ma cog zlum mtheb kyus bskor ba dang*/ gzhan yi dam dang chos skyong gi gtor bsngo dang 'brel na der thus kyi/ ma 'brel na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod sbreng tshar du bsham/ nub dang por dgos pa'i mkha' 'gro spyi gtor zhig kyang logs su gzhag go /rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod/ me tog bcas sta gon bya/ de nas rang nyid stan la 'khod de/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma chab kyis bran te/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya ho bha ga wān badzra rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha hoḥhrīḥzhes pa lan gsum gyi tshe lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis ka bya khyung gi phyag rgya rnams bstan te byin gyis brlabs/ phaiṃ badzra ā ralli hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki n+yaḥs ma ya st+waṃ dṛ shya hoḥzhes dang*/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas dpral ba'i dbyes su bskor ba dang bcas te/ 'dzam bu gling na gdod nas grub pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsams la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi/ sarba yakṣa/ rakṣa sogs mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags lan gsum gyis bsngos/

oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul la/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang zhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje phag mo'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bsgom bzlas kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'tshal na/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis bsnyen pa mthar ma phyin bar gyi bar chad thams cad srung ba dang*/ de nas kyang byang chub ma thob bar gyi bar chad zhi ba'i stong grogs mdzod cig ces dang*/ muḥzhes brjod cing lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje dang bcas sa la reg cing*/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can/ gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba de dag sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig ces dang*/ gtor ma phyir dor/ sumbha ni brjod cing gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brabs te mtshams bcad/ mchod pa rnams la nang mchod nas rdo rje'i rtses gtor la/ sum bha ni sogs zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon sogs nas nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar dang ghaṇḍe ra ṇi lan gsum bcas pas byin dbab/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams gsal btab la/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o zhes sogs kyis skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste bdag gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa'i bar dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa ltar nyams su blangs/

bzlas pa ni sngags 'khor ba'i dmigs pa la sems gtad cing*/ hrīḥyig ring cha tsheg drag can ci nus bsags nas 'od zer spro sdud kyi dmigs pa ni dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar dang*/ khyad par chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim pas bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skyes par bsam pa sogs sems ma yengs par bya'o// thun las ldang ba na/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad sbyangs nas/ shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros dang gzungs dang spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa rgyas pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes sam/ rgyal ba kun yum badzra wa hī sa// bdag la gzhung mang 'dzin dang 'chad rtsod rtsom// bcu phrag rig gnas shes pa'i blo gros dang*// legs bshad 'dzad med ngag gi dbang phyug stsol// zhes pa lta bu gang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim zhes brjod/ gtor ma 'bul na/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar g.yon du bskor ba dang bcas te/ phaiṃ rang gi hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun rdo rje phag mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsams la dkyus ltar 'bul/ gtor bsngo gzhan dang 'brel na des thus la/ ma 'brel na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor yang 'bul na legs/ oṃ badzra muḥzhes pas gtor mgron gshegs su gsol/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje phag mo 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam gang shes dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// de lta bu'i rim pas grangs kyi bsnyen par sngags 'bum phrag drug la sogs pa dang*/

dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba gcig dang*/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa la ni rtags kho na las tshad la nges pa ma mchis so// zhes rdo rje phag mo dkar mo'i bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge nyung gsal zhes bya ba 'di'ang don gnyer mgon po skyabs kyi ngor bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// dzambha la dmar po ga'u la brten nas sgrub pa ci 'dod gter gyi bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus pa// rang dbang dgug phyir mgon po 'od dpag med// gzhan don sgyu 'phrul rnam rol dzambha la// gter gyi ga'u la brten sgrub tshul bstan// de la man ngag gi gzhung tshig dgod pa dang*/ de lag tu blang ba'i rim pa bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ grwa pa mngon shes lugs kyi dzaṃ bha la dmar po ga'u la brten nas sgrub pa ni/ ga'u zangs sam rdza las byas pa li khri'am mtshal gyis dmar por byugs la/ 'khor lo dpe'u chung bzhin bris la/ de'i nang btsal bya'i rdzas la/ phyug po che dgu'i nas sna/ g.yang gi nas sna/ phyug po chen po bu bdun pha ma'i nas sna'i 'bru dang nor sna dang*/ gnag rta lug ba ra la sogs pa'i spu dang*/ gser g.yu zangs dngul/ lcags la sogs pa'i rin po che/ zhing mu ma'i sa/ khang pa bkra shis pa'i sa/ gnas gzhi'i rgya thab kyi sa/ dge bshes bsod nams can gyi gdan sa/ mi bsod nams can gyi gos kyi dum bu/ ga pur la sogs pa'i sman sna/ tshong 'dus chen po'i sa/ rkun chen gyi lag pa/ zas sna'i rigs gang 'byor/ na chung 'phyon ma'i ka cha/ skyes bu gzhon nu'i nor sna/ dge bshes kyi thugs dam rten/ yon bdag phyug po'i sems rten te lnga po des de rnams dbang du 'du'o// lo legs pa'i snye ma/ tshong legs pa'i nor gyi dum bu/ 'brog legs pa'i mar/ 'bul ba mang po byung ba'i nor sna/ rgyal pos bsdus pa'i nor sna ste/

de rnams sna tshang ma rnyed na'ang gang 'byor bsags la 'khor lo'i nang du bcug la khengs par bkang*/ khyad par rang gang dga' zhing 'dod pa'i dngos po de dang de'i ming rnams yi ger bris la dngos grub stsol zhes bris pa gzhug dus dus su mchod bstod bya/ rang la 'bul ba byung ba'i phud dang zas phud rnams ga'ur bskyal/ de'i lhag ma dang zas sna rnams dngos grub tu mos la longs spyod/ gos sna rnams lhan par btab la bgo'o// zhes so// gnyis pa de lag tu blang ba'i rim pa la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar ga'u rdzas dang bcas pa bsags nas dgang*/ de'i nang du dzambha la'i sku bris 'bur gang rung dang*/ mtshal dang rin po che brdar bas/ shog bu la dzambha la'i sngags bris pa'i mthar/ 'phags pa dzambha la rten 'di nyid la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas/ rten 'di nyid gang du bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs su/ dgon sde'i phyir yin na phyogs thams cad nas mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan can nam/ chos spyod dge ba bcu lhur len pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi tshogs brgya stong phrag mang po rtag tu 'du ba dang*/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rgyal po blon po btsun mo mi chen la sogs pa stobs ldan 'byor ldan dad ldan mi dang mi ma yin pa'i skye 'gro thams cad rang dbang du 'du ba dang*/ 'jig rten khams kyi zas gos longs spyod gser dngul dkor nor 'bru'i rigs dang*/ rta phyugs bzhon ma la sogs pa 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgya mtsho chen po la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes sam/ phal pa yin na/ sa phyogs 'dir/ phyogs thams cad nas stobs ldan dang 'byor ldan dang mkhyen ldan gyi skye 'gro mi dang mi ma yin pa'i skye 'gro thams cad sogs man chad sngar bzhin bris pa'i shog dril mang po dar gos kyi na bza' gsol te/

sku dang 'dod gsol 'di dag la rab gnas mdor bsdus byas te/ nor rdzas g.yang rdzas bcas pa rnams dang lhan cig mgo mjug ma log par bcug ste/ stegs bu'i khar tshom bu dgu bkod pa'i steng du bzhag go /dbang gi 'khor lo bris pa rnams kyang de'i nye logs kun du dgram/ mtha' skor kun du mchod gtor ci 'byor gyis bskor bas bag dro ba bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rang nyid de dag gi mdun la sogs par stan bde bar byang du zhal phyogs par gnas pas/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi ltar dang*/ bdag bskyed bsgom bzlas dkyus ltar grub rjes/ mdun gyi ga'u sku rten 'khor lo dang bcas pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i ga'u/ rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du/ rin po che dang 'bru bcud zas nor longs spyod 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang bar gyur par bsams la/ tshig lhug pa rnams med pa'i sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs shing rgyas par spel/ de lta bu'i gzhal yas khang gi nang stod kyi cha dang 'khor lo rnams kyi gnas su/ a las zla ba ma las nyi ma sogs kyis dzambha la rnams kyi thugs ka'i ku ru kuller bcas pa sgrub thabs ltar bskyed/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ mchod bstod byas la/ mgon po dzambha la rten 'di nyid la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas rten 'di nyid gang du bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs su/ phyogs thams cad nas gong gi 'dod gsol gyi rigs 'gres 'dod don gsol gdab brjod/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun gyi dzambha la'i thugs brgyud bskul bas/ thugs ka'i ku ru kulle'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas/ las byed kyi ku ru kulle'i dmar mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa dpag tu med pa spros te/

'jig rten khams kyi mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi tshogs grangs med pa dang*/ stobs ldan 'byor ldan dad ldan gyi skye 'gro thams cad dang*/ de dag gi zas nor dpal 'byor/ longs spyod dbang phyug rin po che/ 'bru rigs/ rta phyugs 'phel ba la sogs pa 'byor ba'i khyad par yid la ji ltar 'dod pa thams cad bkug ste/ rang gi gnas khang lung pa thams cad mer gyis khengs pa dang*/ nor rdzas rnams ga'u'i nor rdzas dang dbyer med du bstim/ de bzhin du dzambha la'i zhal dang*/ ne'u le gnyis dang*/ zhabs 'og gi nor bdag rnams las kyang gser dngul mu tig sogs 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor bsam gyis mi khyab pa skyugs par bsams la sngags bzla'o// khyad par 'khor lo'i lha la/ rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu sarba lo ka wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥzhes pa'am/ chos dang srid pa'i dpal 'byor ldan pa'i skye 'gro thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥzhes btags pa'ang ci nus dang*/ 'khor lo'i sngags/ oṃ hrīḥdzambha la dza lend+ra ya 'gro ba mi'i tsitta la sogs pa wa shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar gyis mi sems bsgul ba'i sngags tshig bar gyi bdun pa'ang cung zad re bzlas pa dmigs pa ni/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i las byed mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa rnams kyis/ lha mi klu'i 'jig rten khams kyi stobs ldan 'byor ldan gyi skye 'gro ma lus pa dbang du bsdus nas/ de dag gi tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang dpal 'byor longs spyod nor 'bru la sogs pa'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus nas/ ga'u'i nang rdzas rnams dang rang gi gnas khang lung pa yul phyogs thams cad 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor phun sam tshogs pas gang zhing rang dbang du 'byor ba dang*/ phyogs thams cad nas chos spyod dge ba bcu sgrub pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun grangs med pa 'du zhing de dag gis kyang chos spyod bcu'i bshad sgrub la dbang 'byor par gyur nas phyogs der chos dang srid pa'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par bsams la sngags bzlas pa'i mthar/

me tog thogs te ga'u nang gi lha dang 'khor lo'i lha rnams la/ mgon po dzambha la rten 'di nyid la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas/ rten 'di nyid gang du bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs su/ phyogs thams cad nas sogs 'dod don gsol gdab gong ltar brjod do// thun bsdu ba na/ mchod bstod sngar ltar byas/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ dkyus ltar 'bul la mchod bstod byas/ 'dod gsol gyi mthar/ 'khor lo'i lha rnams 'od du zhu nas/ 'jig rten khams kyi stobs ldan 'byor ldan gyi skye 'gro bsod nams dpal 'byor 'dod dgu'i longs spyod dang bcas pa thams cad dbang du sdud par byed pa'i nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa bris pa'i 'khor lo'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur ces brjod cing bsam mo// de lta bu'i sgo nas thun re la sngags ci nus bzla'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bya ba dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya'o// grol ba'i nyin bkra shis rgyas par brjod la/ ga'u mdzod kyi phugs la sogs par sbas te bzhag go /'khor lo ni blta ba'i dam tshig gi dbang gi rten gyi nang du 'jog pa'am lus la 'dogs rgyu gang nges par byas nas gang bab bya'o// de ltar tshul bzhin bsgrubs pas dkyus nas 'byung ba'i phan yon rnams mi bslu bar 'byung ba ni/ gsang sngags zab mo'i bden pa'i stobs kyis so// gang zhig kha na ma tho med pa'i dpal// ci 'dod gter gyi bum bzang sgrub pa'i thabs// 'di bgyis dge bas 'gro rnams sdig med kyi// phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i gter la spyod gyur cig /ces grwa pa mngon shes lugs kyi dzambha la dmar po ga'u la brten nas sgrub pa ci 'dod gter gyi bum bzang zhes bya ba 'di'ang dge bshes shes rab bstan 'dzin pas bskul ba'i ngor/ karma chags med pas mdzad pa'i zin bris kyi kha 'gengs su bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa dge'o//
// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
